description:
Support your baby's coordination and motor skills through every step of early development with the Strider Baby Balance Bike. This super fun indoor toy takes them from tummy time to toddling, starting with sensory fun in the nursery and growing with them as they learn to explore the world on two feet — and two wheels! .
From day one, the Strider Baby Balance Bike sparks their curiosity with new tactile experiences that strengthen their growing brain. Watch as they feel the bumpy handlebar grips and spin the wheels, finding new ways to interact with their bike every day. Made with soft colors that perfectly complement your nursery, and with no overstimulating lights or sounds, it’s ideal for curious littles.
As they learn to stand and walk, the Strider Baby Balance Bike accelerates their full body coordination. With two feet and two wheels on the floor, your little one learns to balance themselves and even steer through the house. The super lightweight walk-with-me design helps their confidence soar, and the no-scratch tires give you peace of mind as you stride through the house together.
Before they’re ready to zoom off, your baby is already learning the building blocks of balance and coordination that will propel them forward. The Strider Baby Balance Bike is their first adventure buddy, as they explore the world around them.
